Definition: from G575 and G2525; to reconstitute (in health, home or organization):--restore (again).
BiblicalUsage: To restore, to put back in place. Jesus says Elias truly shall first come and restore all things in Matthew 17:11, and repeats it in Mark 9:12. The disciples ask the risen Lord in Acts 1:6 whether He will at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel, and the writer of Hebrews asks prayer that he may be restored to his readers the sooner in Hebrews 13:19.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that restoration runs from the greatest thing to the smallest: all things, the kingdom, and one man's return to his friends. The same word covers Elijah's coming work and a prisoner's hope of seeing his church again. God restores on every scale, and none of it is beneath Him.
